We are a chiropractic and rehabilitation office located in Dublin, OH. CCRC’s goals are to empower movement and improve people’s health by addressing functional causes of injuries. At CCRC the goal is simple; help restore normal function of muscles and joints by utilization of chiropractic care, functional rehabilitation, and improve performance. Here you can count on an individualized, non cookie cutter approach to getting you back to the activities you enjoy.  

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel for ongoing content on all things related to sports injuries, as well as exercises and tools to progress your performance forward!
